entities.summary: Kaijūsen-ji is a Buddhist temple in Kizugawa, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Its five-storied pagoda is a National Treasure of Japan. Kaijūsen-ji Temple is a Buddhist temple in Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
